He is 71. Stage 3 lung cancer. 4 months to live. He refused chemo.

His words:

"I'm not doing chemo. I spent 14 years standing 20 feet from the machine that could cure me in half an hour. They won't let me use it. Because I'm 'civilian status' since retirement."

⟁

THE CONFESSION:

"From 2005 to 2019, I ran security for what the CIA calls 'The Wellness Program.' Three facilities: Virginia, Colorado, one offshore on a vessel with no flag."

"Each facility had 4-7 operational regeneration chambers. The public calls them MedBeds. We called them 'units.'"

"The Virginia facility processed 200 patients per year. Senators. Generals. Agency directors. Their families."

"I watched a 74-year-old Director walk in grey-skinned, unable to stand. Liver failure. He walked out 6 hours later looking 55. Drove himself home."

"I watched this hundreds of times."

⟁

THE RULES:

"Three rules:"
"1. No one below GS-14 clearance."
"2. No civilian family unless Director-approved."
"3. No records leave. Servers auto-delete every 72 hours."

"That's why there's no paper trail. The only evidence is in the memories of people who were there. That's why I'm talking — my memory won't last much longer."

⟁

WHY HE CAN'T USE IT:

"I called my former supervisor. Said: 'Jim, I have cancer. You know what's in that building. I need 30 minutes.'"

"He said: 'You're civilian now.'"

"I said: 'I guarded that machine for 14 years. I kept everyone's secrets. I'm asking for 30 minutes.'"

"He hung up. Called back four times. Never answered."

⟁

"That's when I understood. I wasn't security. I was a prison guard. The prisoners were every American who got sick and died while that machine sat empty."

"In 14 years: 2,800 patients. Zero failures. Cancer, organ failure, neurological damage, aging — reversed. Every time."

"Every patient was government or military. Not one regular citizen. Not one veteran from the VA down the road. Not one taxpayer who FUNDED the program."

"They paid for the technology. They paid my salary to guard it. They were never allowed to use it."

"I enforced that for 14 years. I'm sorry. I'm dying sorry."

📡 Martyr Ayatollah Khamenei’s decisions were based on wisdom: Veteran politician

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Gholam-Ali Haddad Adel, a veteran politician and member of the Supreme Council of Cultural Revolution, says Martyr Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei used to make decisions based on wisdom, despite political pressures.

Speaking at a ceremony to commemorate the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution and several members of his household, at Tehran’s Tarbiat Modares University, Haddad Adel referred to the late Ayatollah Khamenei as the “Wise Leader,” saying he also emphasized the three principles of “honor, wisdom, and expediency” in foreign policy.
​
Stating that wise action means making decisions based on a correct understanding of the conditions and foresight in many of the country’s issues, he cited the martyred Leader’s wise perspective and decisions in managing certain crises, including the events of 2019.
​
He noted that Ayatollah Khamenei possessed extensive knowledge in various scientific, historical, cultural, and technological subjects that helped him preserve the principle of the country’s system and interests.
​
Referring to the historic funeral ceremonies for the Leader of the Islamic Revolution and his family, Haddad Adel expressed gratitude to the Iranian and Iraqi nations for creating a great epic, turning the funeral into an important chapter for the Islamic Revolution.
​
Pointing to the scientific endeavor of the late Leader, he described Tarbiat Modares University as one of the examples and relics of Ayatollah Khamenei’s time in office, adding that the martyred Leader paid special attention to its foundation and achievement.
​
Haddad Adel said that numerous scientific institutions, foundations, and councils were formed during the 36-year leadership of Martyr Ayatollah Khamenei, as well as through his active support, advice, and follow-up, including in areas such as nuclear technology, nanotechnology, biotechnology, stem cells, cognitive sciences, and information technology.
​
A country that faced difficulties even in providing barbed wire at the beginning of the revolution, today, thanks to scientific and technological development, has been able to maintain its power in various fields, he added.
